reference_guided_asset_gate.note: Generated complex assets must use prompts tied to the selected master/source role, style, viewpoint, proportions, and placement.

no_coarse_asset_gate.note: A few broad assets cannot substitute for a complete fine-region inventory.

no_crop_gate.note: Complex visuals are represented by independently generated no-text transparent assets; the Image2 master is used only as a layout contract.
